treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Singapore and the Kingdom of Spain for the avoidance of double taxation (2011; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: Date of Conclusion: 13 April 2011 Entry into Force: 2 February 2012 Effective Date: 1 January 2013. Art. 28(2)(a)(i): in respect of tax withheld at the source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents, on or after 1 January of the calendar year next following the date on which the Agreement enters into force
source_title: IRAS consolidated text: Singapore-Spain DTA (ratified)(MLI)(1 Jul 2022), incl. Protocol 2011 and Annex A MLI effects

rates.quote: (i) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(ii) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases;

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: MLI art. 7(1) (replacing para 1(d) of the Protocol)
ppt.quote: “(d) Notwithstanding any provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ...” (Annex A para 4(b)(i): taxes withheld at source ... on or after 1 January 2023)

notes: Before the MLI, Protocol para 1(d) contained a main-purpose test specific to Arts. 10-12. Not modelled: Art. 10(2)(b) 5% for REIT distributions (S-REIT / SOCIMI) where holder has <10% of value; interest taxable only in residence State for State/central bank/government entities, State-paid interest, financial institution-to-financial institution interest, approved pension funds, export-credit / government-guaranteed loans (Art. 11(3)). Protocol para 4: Spanish reductions limited to amounts remitted to Singapore where Singapore taxes on remittance basis. MLI Art. 8 not applied.
